persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.
bank.Event wording: Lantern Night Market; 18 September 2027; 6–10 PM; Riverside Yard; Free entry. Include all five on every asset.
bank.Deliverables and dimensions: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 9:16 reel.
bank.Visual style: Warm lantern imagery with midnight blue and gold; the three assets should visibly belong together.
bank.Music, voice and animation: Your call; no voiceover is needed.
bank.Additional copy or logo: No logo or additional event details are needed.

messages.text: Could you make me a matching event pack with a poster, a vertical story image and a vertical reel that all look like they belong together? I’m excited about this event, and having the visuals together will make it feel a bit more real to me. The poster should be 4:5 and the reel should be 10 seconds long, and all three need to say Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. For the look, please use warm lanterns with midnight blue and gold. I always worry that I’ll get caught up in how pretty something looks and forget whether people can actually read it. Please keep the reel text easy to read.
